Reading the data

Data is organized across three geographic levels: county/ (Census tracts across Florida counties), state/ (all 67 Florida counties and statewide totals, 2010–2024), and country/ (United States national totals, 2010–2024). Estimates come from the U.S. Census Bureau’s American Community Survey (ACS) 5-year releases (B07001 for migration, B05002 for nativity and citizenship, B03002 for race and Hispanic origin, and B19013, B17001, B23025, B25064, B25077 for economic conditions).

title: About this project.
text:
DATA & METHODOLOGY


About this project.


How this dashboard tracks migration flows, foreign-born populations, race and ethnicity, and economic conditions across Florida’s 67 counties and 5,100+ Census tracts.







THREE GEOGRAPHIC SCALES


Data organization


Reproducible via download.R


All data is downloaded from the U.S. Census Bureau’s American Community Survey (ACS) 5-year estimates using tidycensus and tigris in download.R and stored across three folders:



county/Sarasota County tract trends (2010–2024), all 5,160 Florida Census tracts (2024), and simplified tract boundary polygons.


state/All 67 Florida counties and Florida statewide totals from 2010 through 2024, plus Florida county boundaries.


country/All 50 U.S. states and United States national benchmarks from 2010 through 2024.







ACS 5-YEAR TABLES


Measures tracked


2010–2024 ACS 5-Year



Migration (B07001)Share of residents who lived in the same house 1 year ago, moved within the same county, moved from another Florida county, moved from another U.S. state, or moved from abroad.


Foreign-Born (B05002)Total foreign-born residents, foreign-born percentage of total population, naturalized U.S. citizens, and non-U.S. citizens.


Ethnicity & Race (B03002)Hispanic or Latino population share alongside non-Hispanic White, Black, and Asian population shares.


Income & Poverty (B19013, B17001)Median household income (in nominal release-year dollars) and percentage of residents with income below the federal poverty level.


Employment (B23025)Civilian unemployment rate among the civilian labor force (available from the 2011 ACS 5-year release onward).


Housing Costs (B25064, B25077)Median gross rent and median owner-occupied home value.




Methodological notes

ACS 5-year estimates pool 60 months of survey responses to provide reliable neighborhood-level data for Census tracts. Uninhabited offshore water tracts and special land-use tracts with fewer than 100 residents (such as airports) are excluded from percentage rankings so small denominators do not distort county color scales.
